item.title: 'HTN' From The Looksmaxxing Community's 'PSL Scale' Trends Online
item.description: HTN is a looksmaxxing slang term meaning High Tier Normie, which is part of the PSL scale that the community uses to grade and categorize people's looks into various groups. The abbreviation notably uses the slang normie, meaning an individual who is deemed "normal." The term appeared online as early as 2019, spreading from forums to platforms like TikTok throughout the 2020s. item.title: Videos Of The 'Homer Ritual' From The 'Roblox' Horror Game 'You vs. Homer' Go Viral
item.description: Homer Ritual is a meme trend in the Roblox survival horror game You vs. Homer, inspired by The Simpsons, where players in the role of Bart circle around Homer as if performing a ritual on him, often while the song "Laughing Vity Jersey" by PM_FOUR plays. Videos of the trend were popularized on TikTok in January 2026 as You vs. Homer experienced a peak in popularity.

item.title: Strange New Meme Format About Shawty's Effortless Ability To Make You Go Broke Goes Viral On TikTok
item.description: When Shawty Talm Bout "Make It a Meal" or Crispy $5 In My Pocket is a series of image macro memes in which an absurd caricature of a celebrity or character is paired with a caption about a girl asking her date to order too much food, forcing the date to worry whether the crispy money in his pocket is enough or not. The memes, often set to a whistling rendition of "The Lion Sleeps Tonight," were popularized on TikTok in mid-January 2026.

item.title: TikToker Commenting 'What Have I Started' Becomes A Viral Character On The App
item.description: Takuya Yagami "What Have I Started 😭✌️ refers to a comment left by TikToker @fall.zoiddd, aka Takuya Yagami, under a variety of videos throughout late 2025 and 2026, always writing, "what have i started 😭✌️" as if claiming that they started the trend or meme shown in the video. While it is unclear when exactly Yagami started leaving the comment, videos about Yagami started going up on TikTok as early as November 2025.

item.title: John Pork Trends Online Amid Story About LA Cop Receiving Starbucks Cup With Drawing Of Meme Character
item.description: John Pork is a virtual influencer that resembles a realistic anthropomorphic pigman, depicted as a man with a human body and a pig's head. He first began posting content to Instagram in 2018 and continued to post over the following years, spreading from Instagram to TikTok. John Pork's uncanny look inspired memes across social media, including a series of memes about pork being Technoblade's real face.
